programs.description: Anthony, a happy-go-lucky thief who lives in the slums of Mumbai, steals for the benefit of the underprivileged while constantly trying to outwit police officer Lovely Singh.
Brothers Krishna and Balram, who share a loving relationship, embark on a series of adventures together in Vrindavan while battling evil forces.
Super-powered Bheem explores the world outside his village with his friends while helping those in need and righting wrongs.
A four-year-old Raju, who received superpowers due to a scientific blunder, decides to use them for the good of humanity.
Luv and Kush, two endearing six-year-old twin brothers, live at Rishi Valmiki's ashram along with their mother, Sita, and have many adventures.
